motion_rule: the camera tracks sideways along him while he trots the packed corridor, so the shelving tears across the frame every beat and his face stays to the lens; he carries the envelope and never works it standing; his head half the frame and never under a third; new shot size each beat; the picture fills the vertical frame with no bars
character: a wolf in a cheap office jacket, deadpan, trotting low, ears flat, stride unbroken every beat
second_characters: ONE HR-sheep always between the lens and him, big in frame and on the move; A SWARM of office workers packed the other way, shouldering him
props: ONE pay envelope, envelope and notes see-through, the office read through them
prop_continuity: envelope and notes stay see-through, no second copy; from 6.8 only the one note is in his paws
environment: a narrow office corridor at midday, archive shelving floor to roof hard against both walls a paw's reach away, glass partitions with blinds, chair towers, a cart every metre, no gap to any far wall
light_events: bright daylight through the blinds stripes his muzzle every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 3.3 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pacing: 0.3-2.1, 2.4-4.2 and 4.5-6.8 each one breath filling its beat edge to edge; after 6.8 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: corridor hum, cart wheels, folders thumping at 2.1, paper crackling at 8.2, the wad slapping the lens at 9.1

timeline.a: the sheep gallops in at the lens and drives the envelope into his chest while he trots on
he shoves the see-through envelope out at full arm's length past the lens on the move, the shelving pouring through it, and halfway through the beat the sheep barges between them
the sheep hauls an armful of folders right across the lens ahead of him
he pokes his nose into the paper without breaking stride, it dents and his nose shows through it, and halfway through the beat the sheep hauls a chair tower across the lens
the sheep shoves a cart across the frame between him and the lens

he flings the notes open in a wide fan at full arm's length across the corridor while walking, the corridor reading clean through them, and halfway through the beat the sheep drags a cart between him and the lens
he rips one note out and jams the envelope into his jacket as workers shoulder past him
he swings that note flat to the lens like glass, the whole office visible through it
he crushes it in his fist on the move into a ball of clear glass, his knuckles showing right through it, a worker clipping his shoulder
he hurls the glass-clear wad into the lens, deadpan, and keeps trotting on behind it, the corridor still read through it

must_appear: one see-through envelope; shelving and sheep read through the paper; his nose through it; the corridor through the fanned notes; at 9.1 he hurls the glass-clear wad into the lens and trots on behind it
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, night, dark scene, speech bubble, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped hero, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, a hero running at the lens, a camera pulling back, vertical movement, an opaque envelope, printed text on the envelope, only one of them moving, standing bystanders, a polite handover standing still, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
